title: WP-BLD-C: deterministic G07 controls in the canonical gate (badf-build -> VALIDATED)
objective: Enforce, in badf_gate.py, the seven build invariants that BLD-A froze and BLD-B made measurable: C1 a self-dossier is assembled and a PASS dossier accepted only under a demand AUTHORIZED by a human (BLD-I03); C2 source-change.binding.base_sha equals the WP's resolved base_revision and the recomputed content tree equals the binding (BLD-I02); C3 a PASS dossier with unexpected_paths is refused unless the WP declares a discovery_allowance covering them (BLD-I04); C4 when test_obligations declare a red phase every unit-test obligation carries red.observed, otherwise the binding declares tdd.applies=false with a reason -- silence refused (BLD-I07/I08); C5 a unit-test PASS on a PASS dossier requires a composition record for the same WP and base (BLD-I09); C6 ledger RETRY events may not exceed execution_budget.max_attempts and a STOP event forces BLOCKED/HUMAN_REQUIRED (BLD-I11..I13); C7 delegations in build/session.json are strict subsets of the WP's surface and permissions with the prohibited set intact (BLD-I10). Controls fire only on declared fields (existing objects on main stay valid); typed in code, not walker-trusted; no second gate.
business_value: Without these controls the typed evidence describes a build; with them the gate refuses a build that exceeded its authorization, its surface, its budget or its verification contract -- the difference between a coding agent that reports and one that is governed.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: controls C1..C7 in self_dossier / check_g07_binding / validate_dossier (+ read-only ledger inspection for refusal only)
GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0086.json; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconcile WP-2026-0100
tests/test_badf_build_evidence.py + tests/test_badf_self_dossier.py fixtures: declare an AUTHORIZED human demand (BADF-DEM-0001 on main is RESOLVED -- a closed demand authorizes nothing under C1)
out_of_scope: any change to badf_compose.py, the CI workflow, check_schema, or lifecycle.json
executing tests inside the gate; any new schema loosening
acceptance_criteria: each of C1..C7 refuses its violation with a message naming the invariant, and is silent when the governing field is undeclared (BLD-B objects on main unaffected)
failing-first 8 red -> green; mutation: each control's refusal disabled -> its test red (7/7)
existing build_evidence / self_dossier / reconcile / composition / integration suites green; CI green on the composed tree
registry badf-build VALIDATED; QA + REV by BARCHI-1 (shared surface)
tests: tests/test_badf_build_evidence.py (11; fixture now declares a human-AUTHORIZED demand, as C1 requires)
evidence: typed G07 self-dossier (under the new controls)

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
